title: Issue CRUD and identity
description:
Implement the core issue domain: creation with ID generation (SHA256 hash, kbs-{6hex} format), reading (kbs show, kbs list), updates (status transitions, field changes), deletion and closing, ID format validation, and file I/O (read/write issue JSON to project/issues/). Issues are the core domain object everything else depends on.

Spec coverage target: features/issues/ (14), features/hierarchy/ (1), features/index/ -- approximately 16 feature files.
